function.name: select
function.arguments:
{"query":"SELECT
  url,
  title,
  query AS state_query,
  UNNEST(
    SEM_EXTRACT_ALL(
      content,
      'a currently operating U.S. specialty, third-wave, craft, or artisan coffee roasting company; exclude cafes that do not roast and mass-market industrial brands',
      roaster_name := 'company or roaster name',
      city := 'primary roasting location city',
      state := 'primary roasting location U.S. state, two-letter postal abbreviation',
      street_address := 'street address of roasting facility or headquarters',
      founded := 'year or full date the company was founded, started, or established',
      website := 'official company website URL',
      specialty_basis := 'short statement establishing specialty, third-wave, craft, or artisan roasting status',
      roast_profile_or_focus := 'stated roast style, sourcing focus, or coffee specialization',
      cafe := 'whether it operates a cafe, tasting room, or retail shop, yes or no',
      wholesale := 'whether it offers wholesale coffee, yes or no',
      subscription := 'whether it offers a coffee subscription, yes or no',
      certifications_or_distinctions := 'stated certifications, awards, or ownership distinctions',
      evidence := 'per_field'
    ),
    recursive := true
  )
FROM WEB_SEARCH(
  'specialty coffee roasters Alabama directory',
  'artisan coffee roasting company Alabama founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Alaska directory',
  'artisan coffee roasting company Alaska founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Arizona directory',
  'third wave coffee roaster Arizona founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Arkansas directory',
  'artisan coffee roasting company Arkansas founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters California directory',
  'third wave coffee roasting company California founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Colorado directory',
  'artisan coffee roasting company Colorado founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Connecticut directory',
  'third wave coffee roaster Connecticut founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Delaware directory',
  'artisan coffee roasting company Delaware founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Florida directory',
  'third wave coffee roasting company Florida founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Georgia directory',
  'artisan coffee roasting company Georgia founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Hawaii directory',
  'third wave coffee roaster Hawaii founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Idaho directory',
  'artisan coffee roasting company Idaho founded',
  'specialty coffee roasters Illinois directory',
  'third wave coffee roaster Illinois founded'
)
WHERE SEM_MATCH(
  content,
  'identifies at least one currently operating U.S. company that roasts specialty, third-wave, craft, or artisan coffee and gives its city or state'
)","show_preview":false}

{"query":"WITH combined AS (

),
staged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    regexp_extract(url, 'https?://(?:www\\.)?([^/]+)', 1) AS domain,
    CASE
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%District of Columbia%' OR state_query ILIKE '%Washington DC%' THEN 'DC'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Alabama%' THEN 'AL' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Alaska%' THEN 'AK'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Arizona%' THEN 'AZ' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Arkansas%' THEN 'AR'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%California%' THEN 'CA' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Colorado%' THEN 'CO'

      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Massachusetts%' THEN 'MA' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Michigan%' THEN 'MI'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Minnesota%' THEN 'MN' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Mississippi%' THEN 'MS'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Missouri%' THEN 'MO' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Montana%' THEN 'MT'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Nebraska%' THEN 'NE' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Nevada%' THEN 'NV'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%New Hampshire%' THEN 'NH' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%New Jersey%' THEN 'NJ'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%New Mexico%' THEN 'NM' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%New York%' THEN 'NY'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%North Carolina%' THEN 'NC' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%North Dakota%' THEN 'ND'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Ohio%' THEN 'OH' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Oklahoma%' THEN 'OK'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Oregon%' THEN 'OR' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Pennsylvania%' THEN 'PA'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Rhode Island%' THEN 'RI' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%South Carolina%' THEN 'SC'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%South Dakota%' THEN 'SD' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Tennessee%' THEN 'TN'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Texas%' THEN 'TX' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Utah%' THEN 'UT'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Vermont%' THEN 'VT' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Virginia%' THEN 'VA'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%West Virginia%' THEN 'WV' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Washington%' THEN 'WA'
      WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Wisconsin%' THEN 'WI' WHEN state_query ILIKE '%Wyoming%' THEN 'WY'
    END AS target_state,
    CASE
      WHEN upper(trim(state)) IN ('AL','AK','AZ','AR','CA','CO','CT','DE','FL','GA','HI','ID','IL','IN','IA','KS','KY','LA','ME','MD','MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK','OR','PA','RI','SC','SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY','DC') THEN upper(trim(state))
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Alabama' THEN 'AL' WHEN state ILIKE 'Alaska' THEN 'AK' WHEN state ILIKE 'Arizona' THEN 'AZ'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Arkansas' THEN 'AR' WHEN state ILIKE 'California' THEN 'CA' WHEN state ILIKE 'Colorado' OR state ILIKE 'Colo.' THEN 'CO'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Connecticut' THEN 'CT' WHEN state ILIKE 'Delaware' THEN 'DE' WHEN state ILIKE 'Florida' THEN 'FL'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Georgia' THEN 'GA' WHEN state ILIKE 'Hawaii' THEN 'HI' WHEN state ILIKE 'Idaho' THEN 'ID'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Illinois' OR state ILIKE 'Ill.' THEN 'IL' WHEN state ILIKE 'Indiana' THEN 'IN' WHEN state ILIKE 'Iowa' THEN 'IA'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Kansas' THEN 'KS' WHEN state ILIKE 'Kentucky' THEN 'KY' WHEN state ILIKE 'Louisiana' THEN 'LA'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Maine' THEN 'ME' WHEN state ILIKE 'Maryland' THEN 'MD' WHEN state ILIKE 'Massachusetts' THEN 'MA'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Michigan' OR state ILIKE 'Mich.' THEN 'MI' WHEN state ILIKE 'Minnesota' THEN 'MN' WHEN state ILIKE 'Mississippi' THEN 'MS'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Missouri' THEN 'MO' WHEN state ILIKE 'Montana' THEN 'MT' WHEN state ILIKE 'Nebraska' OR state ILIKE 'Neb.' THEN 'NE'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Nevada' OR state ILIKE 'Nev.' THEN 'NV' WHEN state ILIKE 'New Hampshire' OR state ILIKE 'N.H.' THEN 'NH'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'New Jersey' THEN 'NJ' WHEN state ILIKE 'New Mexico' THEN 'NM' WHEN state ILIKE 'New York' THEN 'NY'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'North Carolina' THEN 'NC' WHEN state ILIKE 'North Dakota' THEN 'ND' WHEN state ILIKE 'Ohio' THEN 'OH'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Oklahoma' THEN 'OK' WHEN state ILIKE 'Oregon' THEN 'OR' WHEN state ILIKE 'Pennsylvania' OR state ILIKE 'Pa.' THEN 'PA'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Rhode Island' THEN 'RI' WHEN state ILIKE 'South Carolina' THEN 'SC' WHEN state ILIKE 'South Dakota' THEN 'SD'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Tennessee' THEN 'TN' WHEN state ILIKE 'Texas' THEN 'TX' WHEN state ILIKE 'Utah' THEN 'UT'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Vermont' THEN 'VT' WHEN state ILIKE 'Virginia' OR state ILIKE 'Va.' THEN 'VA'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Washington' THEN 'WA' WHEN state ILIKE 'West Virginia' THEN 'WV' WHEN state ILIKE 'Wisconsin' THEN 'WI'
      WHEN state ILIKE 'Wyoming' THEN 'WY'
    END AS raw_state

),
eligible AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    (
      (CASE WHEN city IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN founded IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN website IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN specialty_basis IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN roast_profile_or_focus IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN cafe IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN wholesale IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN subscription IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN certifications_or_distinctions IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS completeness
  FROM staged
  WHERE roaster_name IS NOT NULL
    AND length(trim(roaster_name)) BETWEEN 2 AND 100
    AND target_state IS NOT NULL
    AND domain IN (
      'roastlocal.com','coffeeroast.com','roastersmap.com','mycoffeeexplorer.com',
      'coffeeroasternearme.com','coffeeroasters.io','brewatlas.co','caffeine.supply',
      'thirdwavecoffeenearme.com','coffeeinsurrection.com','smallcoffeeroasters.com',
      'ibrewmyown.coffee','pulled.coffee','sprudge.com','dailycoffeenews.com','arizonacoffee.com'
    )
    AND (raw_state = target_state OR raw_state IS NULL)
    AND (
      raw_state = target_state
      OR lower(title) LIKE '%' || lower(regexp_extract(state_query, '(Alabama|Alaska|Arizona|Arkansas|California|Colorado|Connecticut|Delaware|Florida|Georgia|Hawaii|Idaho|Illinois|Indiana|Iowa|Kansas|Kentucky|Louisiana|Maine|Maryland|Massachusetts|Michigan|Minnesota|Mississippi|Missouri|Montana|Nebraska|Nevada|New Hampshire|New Jersey|New Mexico|New York|North Carolina|North Dakota|Ohio|Oklahoma|Oregon|Pennsylvania|Rhode Island|South Carolina|South Dakota|Tennessee|Texas|Utah|Vermont|Virginia|Washington|West Virginia|Wisconsin|Wyoming|District of Columbia)', 1)) || '%'
      OR lower(url) LIKE '%' || replace(lower(regexp_extract(state_query, '(Alabama|Alaska|Arizona|Arkansas|California|Colorado|Connecticut|Delaware|Florida|Georgia|Hawaii|Idaho|Illinois|Indiana|Iowa|Kansas|Kentucky|Louisiana|Maine|Maryland|Massachusetts|Michigan|Minnesota|Mississippi|Missouri|Montana|Nebraska|Nevada|New Hampshire|New Jersey|New Mexico|New York|North Carolina|North Dakota|Ohio|Oklahoma|Oregon|Pennsylvania|Rhode Island|South Carolina|South Dakota|Tennessee|Texas|Utah|Vermont|Virginia|Washington|West Virginia|Wisconsin|Wyoming|District of Columbia)', 1)), ' ', '-') || '%'
    )
)
SELECT
  target_state AS state,
  SEM_NORM(roaster_name, 'merge spelling, punctuation, legal suffix, and brand-name variants; keep genuinely different roasters separate') AS roaster,
  MODE(city) FILTER (WHERE city IS NOT NULL) AS city,
  MODE(founded) FILTER (WHERE founded IS NOT NULL) AS founded,
  MODE(website) FILTER (WHERE website LIKE 'http%') AS website,
  MAX_BY(specialty_basis, completeness) FILTER (WHERE specialty_basis IS NOT NULL) AS specialty_basis,
  MAX_BY(roast_profile_or_focus, completeness) FILTER (WHERE roast_profile_or_focus IS NOT NULL) AS roast_focus,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(cafe) LIKE '%yes%') > 0 THEN 'Yes' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cafe IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'No' END AS cafe_or_tasting_room,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(wholesale) LIKE '%yes%') > 0 THEN 'Yes' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wholesale IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'No' END AS wholesale,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(subscription) LIKE '%yes%') > 0 THEN 'Yes' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE subscription IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'No' END AS subscription,
  MAX_BY(certifications_or_distinctions, completeness) FILTER (WHERE certifications_or_distinctions IS NOT NULL) AS distinctions,
  MAX_BY(url, completeness) AS source_url,
  COUNT(DISTINCT url) AS source_mentions
FROM eligible
GROUP BY
  target_state,
  SEM_NORM(roaster_name, 'merge spelling, punctuation, legal suffix, and brand-name variants; keep genuinely different roasters separate')
ORDER BY
  state,
  roaster","show_preview":false}

[View the interactive U.S. specialty coffee roasters map and table](https://select.keenable.ai/artifacts/FxaIroK6jgXcQ7shCQwASw)

Built from state-by-state web queries and aggregated into **3,300 deduplicated roaster entries across 49 states plus Washington, DC**. The report includes founding dates where available, city, website, roast focus, café/wholesale/subscription indicators, distinctions, and source links.

This is a best-effort live-web index rather than an official registry; attribute coverage varies and West Virginia had no entries that passed the final verification filters. The report link is public to anyone who has it.
